title: Sirius Red Staining of Murine Tissues
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j9rcr56
materials: 90 min Sirius Red solution * 8g Picric acid in 200 ml AD (= 4% saturated solution) * Stirr 30 min * Filter * Add 0.2g Direct-Red * Stirr * Filter Picric acid Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #197378 Direct-Red 80 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #365548

steps.title: Prepare HCl Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.01N HCl by performing a 1,015x dilution, mixing 1.97 ml of saturated HCl with 2,000 ml of AD.

steps.title: Incubate Tissues in HCl
steps.instruction: Treat the tissues with the prepared 0.01N HCl for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Mount Coverslip
steps.instruction: Mount the coverslip using DPX (Merck Millipore/EMD Millipore, Catalog #1.00579.0500).
